courseName: Introduction to Computer Networks and Security

response.courseDescription: 455 Introduction to Computer Networks and Security Concepts and implementations of computer networks; architectures, protocol layers, internetworking, addressing case studies, and discussion of security constraints at all layers of the OSI stack from attacker and defender perspectives. (Crosslisted course offered as CPT S 455, E E 455.)
response.coursePrerequisites: CPT S 360, 370, or E E 234, with a C or better; admitted to a major or minor in EECS or Data Analytics.
